do: Use one primary action per surface or decision group.
Write verb-first labels that describe the action outcome.
Use danger only for destructive or irreversible actions.
Use warning for risky but non-destructive actions.
Keep loading visually distinct from disabled.
dont: Do not use generic labels like OK or Click here.
Do not use Button for icon-only actions; use the icon button component pattern.
Do not encode risk only through color.
Do not expose raw colors, spacing, shadows, or durations as public API.
Do not show growth metadata as visible decoration.
info: fullWidth belongs to mobile sheets, stacked actions, and constrained containers.
Material Symbols are allowed through Symbol/Iconography foundations.
State precedence must stay stable for designers, developers, and agents.
